jobs.title: VP of Product & Data
jobs.description:
KYBER1

Location:
Remote-first (CA preferred)
Engagement:
Contract-to-hire or bootstrap-friendly, with a full-time path for the right person

About KYBER1
KYBER1 is an early-stage commerce media company that helps retailers and other data owners turn consented first-party customer and transaction data into media revenue. Commerce media is one of the fastest-growing categories in advertising, but activation is concentrated in a handful of giant networks. We serve everyone else: the thousands of retailers and data-rich organizations with valuable first-party signals and no practical, governed way to bring them to market.
Our platform takes a partner from raw commerce data to activation-ready audiences: ingesting and normalizing first-party signals, resolving identity deterministically, gating PII before it becomes a liability, building audiences aligned to real buying behavior, and activating them across approved channels, including directly to AI planning and buying agents through the open Ad Context Protocol (AdCP). We are agentic by design, in the product and in how we run the company: agents do real work here, and a small team ships what used to take departments.

The Role
We're looking for a VP of Product & Data to own the product function at KYBER1 and drive it from architecture and ambition into shipped, revenue-generating features. While hands-on in the early days, this is a key strategic role, and you will lead product strategy with input from our C-suite and advisors. It's a great opportunity to build something from scratch with huge upside for businesses and advertisers. If you're an ad tech nerd with ideas about the future of agentic advertising, and someone who loves to build, this is an ideal role for you.
You'll partner directly with our Lead Engineer to run one unified execution loop: you turn the platform strategy and roadmap into a small number of clearly defined use cases, translate each one into user stories, and work closely with engineering on agile and agentic execution.
Because we're a startup, we're flexible on how we start working together. We're open to a contract-to-hire arrangement or a bootstrap-style engagement, and a full-time opportunity with equity is on the table for the right talent.

What You'll Do
Set product strategy and vision. Define where KYBER1's product goes across Audience Extension, KYBER1 Sales, Audience Activation, and the Agentic/AdCP ecosystem, working directly with founders and advisors to turn a strong technical thesis into a sequenced, buildable plan.
Partner with engineering on overall architecture. Sit alongside our Lead Engineer as the other half of technical and product leadership, shaping system design and technical roadmap decisions together, not handing off a spec and waiting to see what comes back.
Bring an innovative, AI-forward product point of view. Push our thinking on where agentic commerce and AI-driven advertising are headed and use agents themselves as leverage in how the team builds and ships product.
Move fast and ship. Translate strategy into a prioritized backlog, use cases, and tickets engineering can pick up right away, and keep a lightweight cadence, like a weekly build review, that turns ideas into shipped product quickly.
Drive the near-term proof points: the real-data pilot campaign and match-rate reporting, closing the consent & governance gap with legal/ops, the second partner integration, and the AdCP beta, all sequenced as one flywheel, not a menu of parallel projects.
Own data and privacy requirements. Translate consent terms, data-share agreements, and PII-gating rules into concrete engineering specs: what fields are permitted, what gets redacted or tokenized, and what identity resolution and audience segmentation decisions follow from that.
Work the ad tech and commerce-media specifics: partner and retailer data integrations, DSP/clean-room mechanics, identity and match-rate reporting, and the taxonomy that makes audiences usable to buyers and agents.
Help hire and mentor the product and data function as it grows beyond you.

What We're Looking For
8+ years of product management experience, including meaningful time owning a product area with full accountability for outcomes, not just roadmap input.
Product background in ad tech, ideally including programmatic advertising, DSP/SSP mechanics, or attribution.
A demonstrated record of shipping, concrete examples of turning strategy into a roadmap, and a roadmap into things that went live.
Experience in privacy and data-heavy products is a strong plus: consent and data-governance frameworks, identity resolution, clean rooms, CDPs, or audience/segmentation data.
Retail or commerce media experience is ideal, understanding how retailers and data owners think about monetizing first-party data.
Comfortable writing detailed specs and tickets yourself, not reliant on a separate business-analyst or PM-ops layer to translate your thinking into something engineering can build.
Strong technical fluency to partner directly with engineering: you don't need to write production code, but you need to speak the language of APIs, data pipelines, and identity graphs credibly.
Startup DNA: biased toward action, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by building in a fast, low-process environment.
Collaborative by nature: comfortable pitching in outside your lane, and just as invested in the team's wins as your own
Clear communicator who can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders

Nice to Have
Experience taking a product from zero to one at an early-stage company
Familiarity with emerging agentic ad standards such as the Ad Context Protocol (AdCP), or with agentic/LLM-driven products more broadly
Experience operating inside a retail media network or commerce media business specifically
Background working with identity graphs, clean rooms, or match-rate/attribution reporting as a proof metric
Experience partnering with legal/ops to close data-share or consent agreements without stalling engineering momentum

What We Offer
A ground-floor seat at a commerce media startup where your product decisions become the company's foundation
Flexible engagement to start (contract-to-hire or bootstrap), with a full-time offer, including equity, competitive salary, health benefits, unlimited PTO and fully remote
Direct access to founders and real influence over product and technical strategy
A genuinely agent-native way of working: high leverage, low bureaucracy, and a standard we hold everywhere, assume an agent is on the other side, and that it is choosing whom to trust

To apply, reach out to jobs@kyber1.com

KYBER1 is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse team. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

Why FCC?

At FCC, we’re proud to be 100% invested in Canadian agriculture and food. As a federal Crown corporation, we provide financing, knowledge resources and business management software to over 103,000 customers nationwide.

Here’s what you can expect when you join our team:

Competitive total rewards packages: market-aligned and performance-based salary and incentive programs, flexible and comprehensive group benefit and savings plans, and well-being support through benefits and wellness programs
Purpose-driven work: We build strong relationships, share knowledge and support the people who feed the world
Growth: Learning and development opportunities to help you thrive

Leverage your extensive experience in credit risk modelling, statistics and model management to lead the strategy, development and oversight of FCC’s enterprise risk models.

As Director, Credit Risk Modelling, you’ll guide a team responsible for developing, maintaining and monitoring adjudication, pricing, credit, financial and regulatory risk models. Your leadership and advanced risk modelling expertise will help ensure foundational models are fit for use in allowance, capital and pricing processes, while supporting efficient and timely solutions across FCC.

If you’re a strategic leader who is motivated by helping teams deliver high-value solutions, this might be the role for you!

What you’ll do 

Develop the vision, strategy and roadmap for FCC’s credit risk model management
Oversee the development, monitoring, maintenance and deployment of adjudication, credit, financial, credit risk pricing and regulatory risk models
Advance model management practices, performance monitoring and modelling maturity using industry standards and best practices
Ensure modelling tools, systems, data practices, artificial intelligence and controls support innovative, efficient and well-governed model development
Set team priorities, allocate resources, manage the budget and create a safe, supportive environment where employees feel valued and inspired
Build strong partnerships with business process owners, industry experts, external consultants and third-party credit bureau providers

What you’ll bring To The Team 

Required qualifications: 

A graduate or master’s degree in mathematics, statistics, economics, data sciences or artificial intelligence
At least 10 years of progressive experience developing and implementing adjudication, financial or regulatory risk models (or an equivalent combination of education and experience)
Extensive knowledge of adjudication, statistics, mathematics, credit, financial and regulatory risk modelling techniques, standards and model management practices in financial institutions
Formal leadership experience in a similar or related field, with the ability to develop strategy, set priorities and inspire a team to execute
Ability to stay current with evolving model development practices, regulatory and financial services environments, and technology advancements
Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with the ability to develop partnerships that support corporate priorities
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, resolve issues and support sound decision-making to deliver pragmatic, simple solutions

Preferred qualifications:  

Experience in applying artificial intelligence tools and techniques to modelling practices
Experience in leading large-scale model risk initiatives in the banking or financial services sector aligned to Basel or OSFI regulatory frameworks

Not sure you meet every requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway.

Job Description

About Red Deer

Red Deer sits at the heart of Central Alberta along the QEII corridor, perfectly positioned between Calgary and Edmonton. With more than 100,000 residents and a regional reach of over 300,000, it’s a growing hub for business, services, and opportunity.

Here, big-city amenities meet small-city ease. Enjoy abundant parks and trails, vibrant arts and culture, excellent recreation and education, and a strong sense of community.

With easy access to lakes, outdoor adventures, and the mountains, plus a thriving economy and high quality of life, Red Deer is an inviting place to live, work, and grow.

About The City Of Red Deer Municipal Government

The City of Red Deer is a dynamic municipal organization with a $480M operating budget, a $60M capital program, and a workforce of nearly 1,700 employees. It is focused on growing with purpose by attracting talented, community-minded people who want to make a difference.

Guided by the vision “Our City, One Voice,” Red Deer is building a thriving, inclusive, and connected community, with priorities centered on a vibrant economy, community wellbeing, and strong engagement.

At its core, the City values its people, embracing diverse perspectives and fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and shared success.

Are you a visionary technology leader who can turn digital possibilities into meaningful organizational impact?

The City of Red Deer is seeking a dynamic and forward-thinking Chief Information Officer (CIO) / Director, Digital Services to help shape the future of technology and digital service delivery across our organization. This is an exciting opportunity to lead enterprise technology strategy, champion innovation and modernization, and build the secure, reliable digital foundations that support essential municipal services. If you thrive at the intersection of technology, people and organizational transformation, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact on how we work, serve and grow.

The Opportunity

The City of Red Deer is seeking an accomplished and innovative technology executive to join our Corporate Performance and Supports Division as Chief Information Officer (CIO) / Director, Digital Services
.

Reporting to the Deputy Executive Director, Corporate Performance and Supports, the CIO will provide strategic and operational leadership for the City's enterprise technology environment, guiding digital modernization while ensuring the reliability, security and sustainability of the technology services that support municipal operations and community service delivery.

Leading a diverse team of approximately 50 professionals, the CIO will play a pivotal role in shaping the City's technology future, strengthening organizational capabilities and translating emerging digital opportunities into practical, sustainable solutions.

With responsibility for a broad enterprise portfolio, the successful candidate will provide leadership in six key areas:

Digital Strategy, Governance and Modernization: Shape and advance the City's enterprise technology strategy, architecture and roadmap. Champion innovation, automation and emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, to enable organizational improvement and enhance municipal service delivery.
Technology Infrastructure, Cybersecurity and Resilience: Provide executive oversight of the City's technology infrastructure, cybersecurity and disaster recovery capabilities, ensuring critical systems and services remain secure, reliable and resilient in an increasingly complex digital environment.
Enterprise Solutions and Technology Delivery: Lead the planning, integration and modernization of enterprise applications and technology solutions, working collaboratively across departments to align investments with organizational priorities and deliver sustainable business value.
Technical Services and Customer Experience: Foster a service-oriented technology culture, strengthening technical support, operational performance and the employee experience through responsive, reliable and continuously improving digital services.
Enterprise Data Architecture and Integration: Advance the technical foundations that enable secure, connected and accessible organizational data, supporting effective integration, analytics and informed decision-making across the City.
People Leadership and Financial Stewardship: Inspire and develop a high-performing Digital Services team, strengthen leadership capacity and oversee significant technology investments, partnerships and service delivery models to ensure accountability, sustainability and value.

As the City's senior technology advisor, the CIO will work closely with executive leadership, departments and Council, as required, to navigate complex technology decisions, balance competing priorities and position the organization for long-term success.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise, strong business acumen and a demonstrated ability to lead complex enterprise technology environments. They are a strategic thinker and accomplished people leader who understands the importance of operational excellence while embracing opportunities for innovation and transformation.

They bring sound judgment, exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, and the ability to translate complex technical considerations into clear, practical advice. Equally comfortable setting long-term direction and navigating immediate operational challenges, they inspire confidence, build collaborative partnerships and lead meaningful organizational change.

This is an exceptional opportunity for a technology leader who wants to do more than manage systems. It is an opportunity to shape digital direction, build organizational capability and help transform how municipal services are delivered for the community of Red Deer.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Engineering or a related technical field. An equivalent combination of education and progressively responsible technology leadership experience may be considered.
10+ years of progressively responsible experience in Information Technology or Digital Services, including 5+ years in a technology leadership role with significant responsibility for enterprise technology services, teams and operations.
Experience developing and implementing organization-wide technology strategies, including infrastructure, enterprise applications, cybersecurity, data management and digital modernization.
Experience leading complex technology and data transformation initiatives and supporting teams through organizational change.
Experience managing significant operating and capital budgets, technology investments, vendor relationships and contracts.
Strong technical understanding of enterprise architecture, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, data governance and emerging technologies.
Ability to provide sound strategic and operational advice to senior leaders. Strong judgment and the ability to explain complex technology matters to non-technical audiences.
Experience leading collaborative, accountable teams, developing leaders and building strong working relationships across an organization.

Preferred Qualifications

Graduate education in a related field.
Professional certifications in enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, cloud technologies, data and analytics, artificial intelligence, technology service management or project management.
Senior technology leadership experience in a municipality, public-sector organization, utility or similarly complex organization.
Experience assessing different technology service delivery options, including internal services, managed services, cloud solutions and external partnerships.
Experience leading organization-wide digital modernization and introducing emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence.
Knowledge of municipal operations, public-sector accountability, privacy legislation and regulatory requirements.

What We Offer

In addition to the competitive wages, we offer an excellent benefit package, pension plans, spending accounts and professional development opportunities to support your career growth.

We are committed to a healthy, vibrant, and sustainable community. Our employees are the cornerstone of our organization and working with us will provide you with work-life balance, career growth and job stability.

The opportunity to work in an ever-growing environment and to work with a dedicated and passionate group of people.

Exempt

Regular Full-time

$75.63 to $94.53 per hour ($148,045 to $185,042 per annum)

75 hours biweekly; Monday to Friday, some evening and weekend work may be required when needed.

Additional Information:
Closing date is November 25, 2026, or until a suitable candidate has been found.

We thank you for your application. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

We are a municipal government, eager to meet tomorrow's challenges. Our employees are the cornerstone of our organization. We are always seeking creative and skilled individuals with the ability and desire to lead in our dynamic workplace. Each of our employees brings diverse experiences and perspectives, as well as unique skills and talents to the job. Our diverse employee base ensures an environment where individual, team, and organizational successes are embraced and celebrated. jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe
, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As SVP, Product, you will shape the vision as to where Toptal’s products and platforms go next and then drive the execution to build them. This is the most senior product role in the company. You will report to the Chief Executive Officer, sit on the executive team, and work collaboratively with our Engineering, Design, Finance, Marketing, New Businesses, Professional Services, and Customer leaders. AI is not a line item on your roadmap. It is the roadmap.

You should be Toptal’s foremost expert on what AI means for products and platforms. That means real depth in fine-tuning and post-training, agent design and evaluation, and the economics of running models in production, along with the judgment to know which applies to us. Work directly with our AI researchers rather than through them. We expect both the AI agenda and the product strategy to originate with you. We will react to your plan rather than hand you ours.

This is a hands-on role. You will write your own specs and pull your own data. When you think an agent could take over a piece of work, you will build a rough version and find out whether it holds up before anyone budgets for it. You will sit in product reviews and say what you actually think. We move fast, and we need Product setting the pace. You will own and set the standards for the hiring bar for the product team, bringing in talent that will advance Toptal to the next level.

Your remit runs across the business: the core platform, the talent and client experiences, the internal systems that run it, the products we take to market, and the data and AI platform underneath them. You will work hand in hand with Engineering on the platform all of it runs on, fold acquisitions and new products into the portfolio, and know growth marketing cold, because how a product reaches the market is part of building it.

Product is yours to shape at blazing speed: scoping, sizing the teams, planning headcount, and defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing them off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about landing an A player and treats an open seat as urgent. Your own dedication and hard work will set the tone, and the people you bring in should be inspired to do the best work of their careers on this team. We are looking for the person who will define what an AI-native product organization looks like and then run it successfully.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

AI and agentic product

Own Toptal’s AI product strategy: where agents and models belong across the marketplace, the talent and client experiences, our internal systems, and the products we take to market, along with the business outcomes they carry.
Decide what we build with AI and what we do not, including build-versus-buy on models and tooling and the packaging and pricing of AI-enabled products.
Make AI quality measurable through evals, acceptance bars, and review loops, and partner with Engineering on the platform as its most demanding customer.
Rebuild how Product works using AI, raising the output and judgment of every product manager through AI-assisted discovery, research, prototyping, and analysis. Product managers have to want this rather than comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Portfolio and operating model

Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the whole portfolio: what we build, what we sunset, and how investment is distributed across growth, platform, and operational leverage.
Establish the product operating model and the metrics behind it, so decisions are made on evidence and user research rather than opinion.
Own the product integration of acquisitions and new products, and act as a senior voice of the customer for both talent and clients.

Team and accountability

Decide what a product team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Review the product work directly, develop people against a clear bar, and raise it as the organization grows.

In the first week, expect to:

Work to get up to speed with how the organization runs, including how our operational frameworks work.
Begin building relationships with the CEO, the executive team, and your direct reports.
Begin learning Toptal’s platform architecture, marketplace dynamics, internal tooling, and current AI initiatives and capabilities.

In the first month, expect to:

Assess the current state of the Product organization and its AI maturity: its people, its roadmap, its rituals, and where the gaps are, including the team against the bar this role requires.
Bring the executive team a product strategy no one asked you for.
Become acquainted with the full product portfolio, the company’s goals, and those you will partner with.
Establish a shared view with the CEO and the executive team of the company’s priorities and how product supports them.
Start collaborating closely with your product teams.

In the first three months, expect to:

Own the product portfolio, its strategy, and its roadmap, and be executing your own plan with at least one AI-enabled capability already in production and measured.
Present your resourcing plan and a clear point of view to the executive team on where product investment should concentrate, what should be deprioritized, and why.
Establish or refine the product operating model: planning cadence, prioritization framework, and the metrics the organization will be held to, with the trust of the peers and teams you work with most closely.

In the first six months, expect to:

Show business impact from AI-enabled products in at least two core surfaces, with the evidence behind it, and visible progress against the top portfolio priorities measured against the metrics you defined.
Have the right leadership team in place, with a clear plan to close any remaining gaps.
Be inspiring and mentoring the teams you work with, upleveling how the organization brainstorms, collaborates, and executes, and charting a clear path for scaling Product’s impact.

In the first year, expect to:

Run a product organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with AI leverage embedded in the portfolio and the operating model rather than living in a set of pilots.
Have built an exceptional product team doing the best work of their careers, with a record of building impactful products in a timely and elegant fashion.
Deliver on your roadmap priorities and promises, with a demonstrable link between product investment and business results, and Product established as a trusted, high-leverage function that the rest of the company plans around.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in a technical discipline (Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems). Masters is strongly preferred.
At least 15 years of proven software Product Management experience.
At least 8 years of experience leading Product organizations, including experience leading other product leaders (managing managers).
Proven ability to raise the level of a product organization through the people you hire and develop.
Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, with a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
Experience owning an entire product portfolio at a high-growth technology company, with accountability for business outcomes and not solely delivery.
Demonstrated success setting product strategy at the executive level and translating it into an executable roadmap across multiple teams and domains.
Experience leading AI-enabled products, with a focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.
Deep, hands-on command of modern AI as a product discipline: agentic architectures, harness and orchestration design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation, along with the economics of running models in production. You have shipped these yourself.
Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
Growth marketing fluency. You understand acquisition, activation, conversion, and retention well enough to build for them.
Experience with marketplace, platform, or two-sided business models is a strong plus.
Prior experience working as a Software Engineer is a strong plus.
Comfortable working with SQL or spreadsheets to analyze data, as well as conducting research with internal and external users.
Ability to creatively craft solutions through data and a user-centric approach.
Be meticulous and have a high bar for quality when writing user stories, brainstorming technical approaches, and testing a feature before it is released.
Be humble, willing to learn, and do whatever is needed to help us accomplish our goals.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Experience using agile development methodologies with globally distributed teams and the ability to keep up with a fast-paced and global company.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal, and you will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Maestro, our AI-powered underwriting platform, already runs inside nesto, with AI agents making real-time, policy-based decisions. Build the deployment playbook. Write the repeatable process that takes AI agents from client requirements through testing and client approval into production. Document each agent’s deployment as you go. The playbook is a core deliverable, not a retrospective.
Protect scope. Hold client “small asks” to the config log and SOW change process. Nothing gets absorbed silently.

What You Bring

You have a client-facing delivery background, as an engagement manager, Delivery Director, or Implementation Director.
You have run senior delivery teams on client sites and led working sessions with EVP-level executives.
You have led client AI implementations hands-on, from requirements through production.

You define written exit criteria, produce the artifacts that back them, and document decisions.

Experience implementing your own company’s product at the client.

Comfort building the playbook while running it in a scale-up.

About Bujou Group

Bujou Group is a diversified Canadian business group operating across real estate development, investment management, construction, hospitality, property management, and marketing.

Through our portfolio of companies, including Precedent Developments, Bujou Capital, Bujou Construction Management, Bujou Properties, and Bujou Studios, we are building an integrated platform focused on creating, managing, and growing long-term enterprise value.

We are entering a significant stage of expansion with the launch of the Bujou Mutual Fund Trust (MFT), an investment platform initially offering two funds focused on strategic real estate equity investments and mezzanine lending.

As we establish this investment platform and continue expanding our operating businesses, we are seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to join our executive leadership team.

The Opportunity

This is a unique opportunity to take on a founding executive role in the launch and growth of Bujou Capital’s investment platform, while assuming financial leadership across the entire Bujou Group.

The CFO will be responsible for the financial strategy, management, reporting, and oversight of all Bujou Group companies, with a particular emphasis on establishing and managing the financial operations of the Bujou Mutual Fund Trust and its underlying investment structures.

The successful candidate will play a central role in launching our two initial investment funds, establishing institutional-quality financial infrastructure, supporting capital formation, and positioning the group for significant long-term growth.

We are seeking more than a traditional corporate finance executive. Our ideal candidate has experience operating at the C-suite level within an investment firm, asset management company, private equity platform, real estate investment firm, or capital markets organization.

As an early member of the executive leadership team, the CFO will have meaningful influence over the financial structure and growth of the organization, with equity-based compensation providing an opportunity to participate in the long-term value being created.

Key Responsibilities

1. Bujou Mutual Fund Trust & Investment Management

This will be the most significant and strategically important component of the role.

* Lead the establishment and ongoing financial management of the Bujou Mutual Fund Trust and its two initial investment funds.
* Oversee fund accounting, financial reporting, cash management, capital deployment tracking, and investment performance reporting.
* Establish appropriate financial systems and reporting processes across the MFT, Master Limited Partnership, and underlying investment entities.

* Develop and maintain fund-level financial models, cash flow projections, liquidity forecasts, and performance reporting.

* Support fund capitalization, investor due diligence, financial disclosures, and capital-raising initiatives.
* Ensure financial and operational reporting obligations are met in coordination with legal and regulatory advisors.

2. Group-Wide Financial Leadership

* Assume executive responsibility for financial management across all Bujou Group companies and subsidiaries.

* Develop consolidated financial statements and group-wide financial performance reporting.
* Manage intercompany transactions, capital allocation, and financial structures across operating entities.
* Establish financial controls and reporting systems that support operational efficiency and scalable growth.
* Provide strategic financial guidance to the CEO and executive leadership team.

* Identify opportunities to improve profitability, capital efficiency, and long-term enterprise value.

3. Capital Markets & Corporate Finance

* Support the development and execution of Bujou Group’s long-term capital strategy.
* Work alongside executive leadership to structure financing arrangements, investment transactions, and strategic partnerships.
* Develop sophisticated financial models for acquisitions, developments, investment opportunities, and corporate transactions.
* Support institutional and accredited investor due diligence, financial presentations, and investment reporting.
* Evaluate debt and equity financing alternatives to optimize capital structures across the group.
* Build relationships with financial institutions, investment partners, lenders, and professional advisors.

* Work with the executive team to establish consistent financial reporting across the real estate portfolio.

5. Executive Leadership & Organizational Growth

* Help establish the financial infrastructure required to support Bujou Group’s evolution into a sophisticated investment and operating platform.
* Build and lead internal finance and accounting teams as the organization expands.
* Establish relationships with external accountants, auditors, fund administrators, and other financial service providers.

Job Description

About Red Deer

Red Deer sits at the heart of Central Alberta along the QEII corridor, perfectly positioned between Calgary and Edmonton. With more than 100,000 residents and a regional reach of over 300,000, it’s a growing hub for business, services, and opportunity.

Here, big-city amenities meet small-city ease. Enjoy abundant parks and trails, vibrant arts and culture, excellent recreation and education, and a strong sense of community.

With easy access to lakes, outdoor adventures, and the mountains, plus a thriving economy and high quality of life, Red Deer is an inviting place to live, work, and grow.

About The City Of Red Deer Municipal Government

The City of Red Deer is a dynamic municipal organization with a $480M operating budget, a $60M capital program, and a workforce of nearly 1,700 employees. It is focused on growing with purpose by attracting talented, community-minded people who want to make a difference.

Guided by the vision “Our City, One Voice,” Red Deer is building a thriving, inclusive, and connected community, with priorities centered on a vibrant economy, community wellbeing, and strong engagement.

At its core, the City values its people, embracing diverse perspectives and fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and shared success.

Are you a visionary technology leader who can turn digital possibilities into meaningful organizational impact?

The City of Red Deer is seeking a dynamic and forward-thinking Chief Information Officer (CIO) / Director, Digital Services to help shape the future of technology and digital service delivery across our organization. This is an exciting opportunity to lead enterprise technology strategy, champion innovation and modernization, and build the secure, reliable digital foundations that support essential municipal services. If you thrive at the intersection of technology, people and organizational transformation, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact on how we work, serve and grow.

The Opportunity

The City of Red Deer is seeking an accomplished and innovative technology executive to join our Corporate Performance and Supports Division as Chief Information Officer (CIO) / Director, Digital Services
.

Reporting to the Deputy Executive Director, Corporate Performance and Supports, the CIO will provide strategic and operational leadership for the City's enterprise technology environment, guiding digital modernization while ensuring the reliability, security and sustainability of the technology services that support municipal operations and community service delivery.

Leading a diverse team of approximately 50 professionals, the CIO will play a pivotal role in shaping the City's technology future, strengthening organizational capabilities and translating emerging digital opportunities into practical, sustainable solutions.

With responsibility for a broad enterprise portfolio, the successful candidate will provide leadership in six key areas:

Digital Strategy, Governance and Modernization: Shape and advance the City's enterprise technology strategy, architecture and roadmap. Champion innovation, automation and emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, to enable organizational improvement and enhance municipal service delivery.
Technology Infrastructure, Cybersecurity and Resilience: Provide executive oversight of the City's technology infrastructure, cybersecurity and disaster recovery capabilities, ensuring critical systems and services remain secure, reliable and resilient in an increasingly complex digital environment.
Enterprise Solutions and Technology Delivery: Lead the planning, integration and modernization of enterprise applications and technology solutions, working collaboratively across departments to align investments with organizational priorities and deliver sustainable business value.
Technical Services and Customer Experience: Foster a service-oriented technology culture, strengthening technical support, operational performance and the employee experience through responsive, reliable and continuously improving digital services.
Enterprise Data Architecture and Integration: Advance the technical foundations that enable secure, connected and accessible organizational data, supporting effective integration, analytics and informed decision-making across the City.
People Leadership and Financial Stewardship: Inspire and develop a high-performing Digital Services team, strengthen leadership capacity and oversee significant technology investments, partnerships and service delivery models to ensure accountability, sustainability and value.

As the City's senior technology advisor, the CIO will work closely with executive leadership, departments and Council, as required, to navigate complex technology decisions, balance competing priorities and position the organization for long-term success.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise, strong business acumen and a demonstrated ability to lead complex enterprise technology environments. They are a strategic thinker and accomplished people leader who understands the importance of operational excellence while embracing opportunities for innovation and transformation.

They bring sound judgment, exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, and the ability to translate complex technical considerations into clear, practical advice. Equally comfortable setting long-term direction and navigating immediate operational challenges, they inspire confidence, build collaborative partnerships and lead meaningful organizational change.

Experience leading complex technology and data transformation initiatives and supporting teams through organizational change.

Experience leading collaborative, accountable teams, developing leaders and building strong working relationships across an organization.

new_jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe
, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As SVP, Product, you will shape the vision as to where Toptal’s products and platforms go next and then drive the execution to build them. This is the most senior product role in the company. You will report to the Chief Executive Officer, sit on the executive team, and work collaboratively with our Engineering, Design, Finance, Marketing, New Businesses, Professional Services, and Customer leaders. AI is not a line item on your roadmap. It is the roadmap.

You should be Toptal’s foremost expert on what AI means for products and platforms. That means real depth in fine-tuning and post-training, agent design and evaluation, and the economics of running models in production, along with the judgment to know which applies to us. Work directly with our AI researchers rather than through them. We expect both the AI agenda and the product strategy to originate with you. We will react to your plan rather than hand you ours.

This is a hands-on role. You will write your own specs and pull your own data. When you think an agent could take over a piece of work, you will build a rough version and find out whether it holds up before anyone budgets for it. You will sit in product reviews and say what you actually think. We move fast, and we need Product setting the pace. You will own and set the standards for the hiring bar for the product team, bringing in talent that will advance Toptal to the next level.

Your remit runs across the business: the core platform, the talent and client experiences, the internal systems that run it, the products we take to market, and the data and AI platform underneath them. You will work hand in hand with Engineering on the platform all of it runs on, fold acquisitions and new products into the portfolio, and know growth marketing cold, because how a product reaches the market is part of building it.

Product is yours to shape at blazing speed: scoping, sizing the teams, planning headcount, and defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing them off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about landing an A player and treats an open seat as urgent. Your own dedication and hard work will set the tone, and the people you bring in should be inspired to do the best work of their careers on this team. We are looking for the person who will define what an AI-native product organization looks like and then run it successfully.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

AI and agentic product

Own Toptal’s AI product strategy: where agents and models belong across the marketplace, the talent and client experiences, our internal systems, and the products we take to market, along with the business outcomes they carry.
Decide what we build with AI and what we do not, including build-versus-buy on models and tooling and the packaging and pricing of AI-enabled products.
Make AI quality measurable through evals, acceptance bars, and review loops, and partner with Engineering on the platform as its most demanding customer.
Rebuild how Product works using AI, raising the output and judgment of every product manager through AI-assisted discovery, research, prototyping, and analysis. Product managers have to want this rather than comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Portfolio and operating model

Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the whole portfolio: what we build, what we sunset, and how investment is distributed across growth, platform, and operational leverage.
Establish the product operating model and the metrics behind it, so decisions are made on evidence and user research rather than opinion.
Own the product integration of acquisitions and new products, and act as a senior voice of the customer for both talent and clients.

Team and accountability

Decide what a product team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
Own resourcing and workforce planning, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
Review the product work directly, develop people against a clear bar, and raise it as the organization grows.

In the first week, expect to:

Work to get up to speed with how the organization runs, including how our operational frameworks work.
Begin building relationships with the CEO, the executive team, and your direct reports.
Begin learning Toptal’s platform architecture, marketplace dynamics, internal tooling, and current AI initiatives and capabilities.

In the first month, expect to:

Assess the current state of the Product organization and its AI maturity: its people, its roadmap, its rituals, and where the gaps are, including the team against the bar this role requires.
Bring the executive team a product strategy no one asked you for.
Become acquainted with the full product portfolio, the company’s goals, and those you will partner with.
Establish a shared view with the CEO and the executive team of the company’s priorities and how product supports them.
Start collaborating closely with your product teams.

In the first three months, expect to:

Own the product portfolio, its strategy, and its roadmap, and be executing your own plan with at least one AI-enabled capability already in production and measured.
Present your resourcing plan and a clear point of view to the executive team on where product investment should concentrate, what should be deprioritized, and why.
Establish or refine the product operating model: planning cadence, prioritization framework, and the metrics the organization will be held to, with the trust of the peers and teams you work with most closely.

In the first six months, expect to:

Show business impact from AI-enabled products in at least two core surfaces, with the evidence behind it, and visible progress against the top portfolio priorities measured against the metrics you defined.
Have the right leadership team in place, with a clear plan to close any remaining gaps.
Be inspiring and mentoring the teams you work with, upleveling how the organization brainstorms, collaborates, and executes, and charting a clear path for scaling Product’s impact.

In the first year, expect to:

Run a product organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with AI leverage embedded in the portfolio and the operating model rather than living in a set of pilots.
Have built an exceptional product team doing the best work of their careers, with a record of building impactful products in a timely and elegant fashion.
Deliver on your roadmap priorities and promises, with a demonstrable link between product investment and business results, and Product established as a trusted, high-leverage function that the rest of the company plans around.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in a technical discipline (Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems). Masters is strongly preferred.
At least 15 years of proven software Product Management experience.
At least 8 years of experience leading Product organizations, including experience leading other product leaders (managing managers).
Proven ability to raise the level of a product organization through the people you hire and develop.
Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, with a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
Experience owning an entire product portfolio at a high-growth technology company, with accountability for business outcomes and not solely delivery.
Demonstrated success setting product strategy at the executive level and translating it into an executable roadmap across multiple teams and domains.
Experience leading AI-enabled products, with a focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.
Deep, hands-on command of modern AI as a product discipline: agentic architectures, harness and orchestration design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation, along with the economics of running models in production. You have shipped these yourself.
Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
Growth marketing fluency. You understand acquisition, activation, conversion, and retention well enough to build for them.
Experience with marketplace, platform, or two-sided business models is a strong plus.
Prior experience working as a Software Engineer is a strong plus.
Comfortable working with SQL or spreadsheets to analyze data, as well as conducting research with internal and external users.
Ability to creatively craft solutions through data and a user-centric approach.
Be meticulous and have a high bar for quality when writing user stories, brainstorming technical approaches, and testing a feature before it is released.
Be humble, willing to learn, and do whatever is needed to help us accomplish our goals.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Experience using agile development methodologies with globally distributed teams and the ability to keep up with a fast-paced and global company.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal, and you will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

The Project Controls Director provides senior leadership and strategic direction for the planning, execution, governance, and continuous improvement of project controls across major projects, programs, portfolios, or enterprise-level workstreams.

This role is accountable for ensuring effective integration of cost control, planning and scheduling, earned value, forecasting, change management, reporting, systems, and performance analysis. The Project Controls Director leads project controls teams, establishes standards and expectations, provides oversight of reporting quality and data integrity, and supports senior leadership in making informed decisions related to project performance, risk, recovery, and delivery outcomes.

Establish, maintain, and oversee project controls processes, standards, procedures, and governance expectations.
Provide leadership and direction for cost control, planning and scheduling, earned value, forecasting, change control, reporting, and performance management activities.
Ensure project controls practices are integrated across cost, schedule, scope, risk, finance, commercial, and reporting functions.
